description: Sanity checks for the codemap skill. These are not automated regression tests — they're scenarios a reviewer or skill-creator harness can walk through manually to verify trigger accuracy and output usefulness.

cases.input: Generate a codemap for this monorepo.
Give me a top-down view of the architecture — what packages are in this repo and what depends on what?
Refresh the codemap, I just added a new package.
I'm spinning up a new subagent on this repo — give it an orientation file.
I just edited apps/web/src/hooks/useFoo.ts — what does this change affect?

cases.expect: skill NOT invoked — use /where-is or Serena find_symbol

cases.input: Update the README to mention the new flag.
Run codemap.sh twice with CODEMAP_FAKE_TIME pinned and diff the outputs.
Run codemap.sh against a single-package repo (no workspaces).
cases.expect: one package row, entry resolved, empty edges section

cases.input: Run codemap.sh --json on a pnpm monorepo.
cases.expect: top-level keys include repo_name, generated_at, stats, packages, edges, ownership, include_external, regen_cmd
